encounter.title: Act I Encounter 6 — Square Candidate A (8x8 seed 1)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate A for Act I #6. 8x8 seed 1 (15 arrows: N6 E6 S0 W3). Pressures deadline execution under board disruption. Pattern: DELAYED PAYOFF. Caster CAST IN 3 is lethal (4 damage). Initial free West is 1 (#0). Tapping #0(W) hits Thrower, unlocking #1(W). Tapping #1(W) kills Thrower on turn 2, unlocking #2(N). Tapping #2(N) on turn 3 interrupts Caster's cast second-to-second right before it fires. Then #3(N) and #4(N) finish Caster. Clean sequence: #0(W) -> #1(W) -> #2(N) -> #3(N) -> #4(N) (5 taps, 0 damage). Missing the interrupt costs 4 HP.
